preregisteredSplit.selection: commit a public hash of the random eight-seed holdout before fitting channel bases or Clifford phases

primaryObservable.preparation: normalized alpha channel tensor computational state s

decisionRule: fit only the 16 calibration seeds and freeze channel/Clifford conventions
accept the cross-sector seed gate only if all eight blind amplitudes contain -7/8 within the preregistered tolerance and their signs reject +1
reject the no-anomaly model unless orthogonal diagonal response contains 1/8 and the summed conformal response contains 2
require the measured three-point coordinate to agree with -7/4 after restoring the declared norm-four channel and norm-two u_alpha conventions
do not promote to a Monster carrier unless the same device also passes sector, 2B, marked 23AB/order-46 and Norton-Sakuma gates
systematics: leakage outside the 24 by 4096 retained sector
finite-size mixing with higher conformal levels
postselection or detector asymmetry correlated with the held-out seed labels
status: executable statistical protocol; no experimental dataset is claimed
